# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and domain analysis generated during assessment.

## Available Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency categorization and compatibility notes.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - API surfaces, contracts, communication patterns, and sequence flow.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, ownership boundaries, ER diagram, and repository methods.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, secrets handling, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows, service-domain mapping, and business decision logic.
